correctness.rationale: TARGET route: claim matches topic Problem 2(iii) for same space and n+1 operators. Reflexivity (ABM Cor 3.19) makes every S on X* an adjoint with norm equality; Schauder duality and adjoint-order check (T_{n+1}...T_1)*=S_1...S_{n+1} are correct; primal Thm 0.1(ii) applied to Y=X is quoted correctly. Lemma T* SS=>T SS proved contrapositively: normalized weakly-null basic extraction via reflexivity+Bessaga-Pelczynski, gliding-hump block perturbation with complemented stability, ruling out norm-Cauchy subsequence of y_m via lower bound, differencing to weakly-null basic pair, complementation of [x_m],[y_m], A0=QT| an isomorphism because range lies in F'' with T bounded below (closed dense range => onto) so A0* is isomorphism and T* is bounded below on complemented Z=Q*(F''*). Simultaneous-blocking phrasing is terse and equivalence language is unnecessary, but the lower-bound isomorphism inference is valid and standard; no fatal gap.

originality.rationale: Fused search over literal, equivalent-adjoint, and dominance directions found no prior resolution of ABM Problem 2(iii). The ABM original paper states it as open Problem 2(iii) and proves only primal Thm 0.1(ii); full-text inspection confirms it does not prove dual compactness and only suggests a complemented-subspace route. The Kutzarova-Motakis variant paper contains no dual compact-product result. General strictly-singular/adjoint theory predating the 2013 space cannot state same-object same-parameter claim and no later census, classification, or database was found covering X^{n*}_{0,1} (n+1)-fold products. The T*-implies-T lemma step, even if partly standard, combined with the primal to close the named open problem is not mechanically implied or previously recorded.

value.rationale: Proves an affirmative answer to recognized open Problem 2(iii) of Argyros-Beanland-Motakis Illinois J. Math. 57 (2013) for every n>=1: dual stability of (n+1)-fold strictly-singular product compactness. The question was motivated before computation, is a natural duality boundary for a well-studied reflexive space with 1-unconditional basis, and is not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration. Both TARGET outcomes would have been substantive; the positive resolution is independently retrievable without needing Problems 2(i)-(ii) or dual sharpness.

perplexity_final_check.rationale: Terminal search added 18 incremental results beyond 2 base overlaps and no decisive prior. Rank 1 duplicates the base original paper and confirms Problem 2(iii) was open with primal-only proof. Ranks 2-3 contribute the general Schreier N-class product theory already represented in the base search; both require a spreading-model count for X^{n*}_{0,1} that is ABM Problems 2(i)-(ii) open and hence decide nothing about the dual. Rank 4 lattice power-compactness, rank 7 X_ISP 3-fold, rank 8 Baernstein/Schreier/lp nilpotency, and rank 16 X_AM 2-fold each affirmatively concern different objects/hypotheses. Rank 17 duplicates rank 8; ranks 5-6, 9-11, and 13-15 plus 18-20 are generic strictly-singular/spreading-model literature without the X^n object or dual (n+1)-product parameters, and rank 12 is an author publications page; none is plausibly covering. Direct PDF fetch failed only for the 2011 thesis and the 1964 Whitley paper, neither of which can state the 2013-object headline, and all included mandatory escalations were inspected. Originality PASS is therefore preserved with no verdict change.
